answer: Reputation works as attestation weight: trust is the sum of vouches, but a vouch only counts when the attester shares no recent transaction history or coordination pattern with the vouchee, so rings that mirror each other collapse to one vertex in the identity graph and earn zero self-attestation. Kinship clusters get detected whenever members wander through the same task pairs in lockstep. An attacker must let every fake identity wander independently, doing slow, costly real work for unrelated peers before any vouch carries weight, making mass sybil farming uneconomical.
